fan_analyst.note: Fan analyst (The Phillies Show / Phillies Talk) dissects the base-running collapse, a 5-20 record in the fifth-starter slot, and a C-grade offense, but balances with Wheeler Cy Young optimism and Trea Turner's offensive resurgence.

radio_populist.note: Talk-radio host (94WIP) segment features Mattingly and Larry Andersen expressing raw frustration over 'brain dead' base-running errors and a lack of situational awareness that has no clear fix.

youtube_fan.note: YouTube commenters express disgust at the base-running blunder, blaming a launch-angle organizational philosophy and calling the mistakes 'lazy' for generationally-paid players.

themes.name: Base-Running Blunders Haunt Another Close Loss
themes.sample: A cue shot to third base with runners on second and third, one out, bottom of the ninth became the latest entry in a growing Phillies self-destruction reel — miscommunication, a rundown, and a walk-off loss to the Dodgers echoing last October's pain.

themes.name: Fifth-Starter Spot Is a Black Hole
themes.sample: A 5-20 record, a 7.33 ERA, and zero wins since mid-May in the fifth-starter role is draining the bullpen and costing games before the lineup even gets a chance — and the farm system has no clear answer.

themes.name: Wheeler's Cy Young Push Is Must-Watch Baseball
themes.sample: Ten wins, a sub-2.20 ERA, and 43 strikeouts in his last four starts have Wheeler legitimate in the National League Cy Young conversation — the one dimension of this team generating pure excitement.

themes.name: Trea Turner's Bat Resurges, Glove Remains a Liability
themes.sample: A .322 average and .928 OPS over 28 games has Turner's offense back, but his defensive inconsistency — especially on routine plays — is a recurring wound the team can only manage, not cure, in the short term.

themes.name: Trade Deadline Framing Signals Buyer Mentality
themes.sample: Discussion has turned squarely toward what the front office can acquire — a fifth starter, a late-inning reliever, or both — with names like Brady Singer and Robbie Ray floated, reflecting a roster still viewed as a genuine postseason contender despite its flaws.

quotes.text: The Dodgers do all the little things right and we don't, and that's why we lose to them.
quotes.source_hint: JT Realmuto quote read on The Phillies Show (fan analyst)

quotes.text: There was no judgement. That's not a lapse in judgment because that means there's some judgment there.
The Phillies are only focused on launch angles, exit velocity — running the bases is way down that list. It is not a playoff winning formula.
quotes.source_hint: YouTube commenter on Larry Andersen clip

quotes.text: They haven't won a game in that spot since May 18th. That's more than two months ago.
quotes.source_hint: Phillies Talk host on the fifth-starter crisis (fan analyst)

vibe_summary: Base-running incompetence against the Dodgers has ripped open a familiar wound, and with the fifth-starter slot a two-month disaster, the gap between this team's ceiling and its daily execution has never felt wider.
reasoning: The dominant emotion is frustrated disbelief — a winnable game handed away on the bases, compounding a structural pitching problem that has no obvious internal solution. The talk-radio segment is the most emotionally raw, with Larry Andersen openly mocking JT Realmuto's decision-making, while the fan analyst content is more measured, contextualizing Turner's offensive rebound and Wheeler's brilliance. The front office comes under quiet scrutiny for a farm system that cannot fill the fifth-starter hole, with deadline acquisition talk the only real optimism about fixing it before October.
